r=Robot();names=[f'robot0_joint{i}_pos' for i in range(1,8)];layout=r.spec()['proprio_layout']
def arr(m):return np.array(m['proprio']['now'],float)
def send(q,n=28):
 a=np.zeros(13);a[:7]=q;a[7]=-1;a[12]=-1
 return r.submit('joint_position',np.tile(a,(n,1)),interpolate='linear',cameras=['robot0_eye_in_hand'],video='none')
o=r.get_obs(cameras=['robot0_eye_in_hand'],video='none');p=arr(o.meta);q=np.array([p[layout.index(x)] for x in names]);R0=np.array(o.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3];print('base p',p[26:29],'q',q,'look',-R0[:,2])
def logR(R):
 c=np.clip((np.trace(R)-1)/2,-1,1);t=np.arccos(c);v=np.array([R[2,1]-R[1,2],R[0,2]-R[2,0],R[1,0]-R[0,1]])
 if t<1e-6:return .5*v
 return t*v/(2*np.sin(t))
J=np.zeros((6,7))
for j in range(7):
 send(q,28)
 b=r.get_obs(cameras=['robot0_eye_in_hand'],video='none');pb=arr(b.meta);rb=np.array(b.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3]
 qp=q.copy();qp[j]+=.04
 rp=send(qp,28);pp=arr(rp.meta);R1=np.array(rp.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3]
 J[:3,j]=(pp[26:29]-pb[26:29])/.04;J[3:,j]=logR(R1@rb.T)/.04
 print(j+1,'dp',J[:3,j],'dw',J[3:,j])
 send(q,28)
print('Jpos',J[:3]);print('final',arr(r.get_obs(cameras=['robot0_eye_in_hand'],video='none').meta)[26:29]);print('status',r.status())
